synopsis: The proposed first-of-a-kind programme has an eleven-month hard deadline, starting preparation in October 2026 ahead of prototype arrival in mid-2027; the indicative plan represents arrival as a July 1, 2027 milestone [f9396, f706, f2, f903]. Preparation is described as about seven months through April 2027 in the planning chapter, but about eight months before mid-2027 in the trust chapter, so these preparation endpoints need reconciliation [f9402, f8237]. The post-arrival campaign is an approximately 16-week iterative funnel, credible within four months only if the requirements-and-design work and most preparation are already complete; environment construction and pipeline correlation should therefore begin before the prototype exists [f7379, f7351, f12229, f3771, f709]. Schedule dependencies include software availability for early software-in-the-loop work and prior agreement on the assessor and review criteria; the proposed end-November 2026 G0 gate records agreed claims, evidence plans, orders, criteria and a named decision-maker [f270, f8245, f12304]. Confidence remains limited: documented capability-building precedents took years, the finance executive calls the schedule optimistic, independent review and retesting can become critical-path activities, and tool implementation and provider delivery timelines were not found [f1203, f10742, f683, f9352, f8838]. The plan should expose dependencies and gaps, report P50/P80 dates and deadline probabilities, and monitor toolchain milestone slips and failure to demonstrate an end-to-end evidence chain for one safety requirement by the first half of 2027 [f9476, f205, f11074, f12196].

relations.note: Both place prototype arrival in mid-2027.
Both report capability-building durations measured in years.
Both make assessor identity and agreed criteria prerequisites for the schedule.
Adds unbudgeted cloud and labeling invoices to milestone-slip and scope-creep warnings.
The indicative plan assigns July 1 to the mid-2027 arrival milestone.
Preparation allowances differ: seven months through April versus eight months before mid-2027.
Defines the approximately four-month delivery window as a 16-week iterative funnel.
Specifies which V-model work must precede the short post-arrival campaign.
Sensor-independent job-site construction enables the recommended early environment build.
The short campaign requires pipeline construction and correlation before prototype arrival.
Early software-in-the-loop work within pipeline preparation depends on executable software availability.
G0 provides a dated gate for signed criteria and a named decision-maker.
Review and retesting risks justify escalation when required physical confirmation lacks schedule reservations.
Years-long precedents support skepticism about the compressed proposed schedule.
Missing implementation durations prevent treating relative integration effort rankings as a schedule.
A layered roadmap with gate diamonds implements dependency-aware plan visualization.
The missing reference class motivates reconstructing internal history to check schedule plausibility.
Absent provider delivery timelines must be reported as not found rather than guessed.
